name: Pyreswipe Hawk
oracle_text:
Flying, haste
Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the greatest mana value among artifacts you control.
Whenever you expend 6, gain control of up to one target artifact for as long as you control this creature. (You expend 6 as you spend your sixth total mana to cast spells during a turn.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you expend 6, gain control of up to one target artifact for as long as you control this creature. (You expend 6 as you spend your sixth total mana to cast spells during a turn.)

needs.what: a trigger event that fires once per turn when the controller's running total of mana spent to cast spells this turn reaches N (expend 4 / expend 6 / expend 8), carrying the threshold N as a trigger key; requires the engine to track per-player total mana spent on spells each turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has spell_cast (fires per spell, not on a cumulative mana threshold) and no value_keys entry reads total mana spent on spells this turn (mana_spent_of reads one spell, spells_cast_this_turn counts spells); a spell_cast trigger with a condition would also fire again on later spells and miss mana crossing the threshold mid-cast. The gain_control half is fine: duration as_long_as_you_control_source already exists.
